questions.title: Which senior Chinese official will hold talks with Jo Yong Won in Pyongyang in the first half of July 2026?
questions.background: Jo Yong Won is a senior official in North Korea's governing Workers' Party. Chinese President Xi Jinping visited North Korea in June 2026 as Beijing and Pyongyang sought closer ties.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: KCNA, as reported by Reuters, identifying the senior Chinese official holding talks with Jo Yong Won in Pyongyang between July 1 and July 15, 2026, inclusive.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-16
  • Accepted Answer Format: string (name). Answer with the Chinese official's full name.
questions.accepted_format: string (name). Answer with the Chinese official's full name.

questions.title: Who will be appointed Peru's foreign minister in the incoming presidential administration's first cabinet in July 2026?
questions.background: A new presidential administration is scheduled to take office in Peru in July 2026. Its foreign minister will oversee the country's diplomatic relations.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Peruvian government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the person officially appointed minister of foreign affairs in the incoming administration's first cabinet, with the appointment announced by July 31, 2026. Speculation about potential appointments does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointed foreign minister's full name.
questions.accepted_format: The appointed foreign minister's full name.

questions.title: Which Southeast Asian country will announce a finalized voluntary repatriation plan for thousands of Myanmar refugees in August 2026?
questions.background: Repatriation means returning refugees to their country of origin. This question concerns finalization of a government plan, rather than the completion of refugee returns.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government statements or reliable news reporting directly quoting those statements.
  • Resolving Event: During August 2026, a Southeast Asian government publicly confirms that it has finalized a voluntary repatriation programme, or the first phase of such a programme, covering at least 1,000 refugees from Myanmar. A preliminary agreement to consider returns is insufficient. Actual departures need not have occurred.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The common English name of the country finalizing the repatriation plan, not the destination country.
questions.accepted_format: The common English name of the country finalizing the repatriation plan, not the destination country.

questions.title: Which candidate will receive the most “encourage” votes in the first UN Security Council straw poll of the 2026 secretary-general selection?
questions.background: António Guterres is serving as UN secretary-general. Informal Security Council straw polls gauge support for potential successors, with members indicating whether they encourage, discourage or have no opinion on each candidate.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official UN information or contemporaneous reporting by reputable international news organizations describing the first Security Council straw poll in the 2026 secretary-general selection process.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the candidate receiving the highest number of “encourage” votes in that first poll, regardless of subsequent polls or the final appointment.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The candidate’s full name.

questions.title: Which international organization, if any, will first gain direct access to Aung San Suu Kyi in detention during 2026?
questions.background: Aung San Suu Kyi has been detained since Myanmar's military overthrew her government in February 2021. Her access to outside visitors has been tightly restricted.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements from the visiting organization or Myanmar authorities, corroborated by established news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: Direct access means a completed in-person meeting with Suu Kyi by a representative acting on behalf of an international organization. Permission or an announced plan without a completed visit does not qualify.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the first international organization publicly confirmed to have completed such a visit during 2026. If no qualifying visit is confirmed by December 31, 2026, resolve that no organization qualified.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The organization's name, or a statement that no organization qualified.
questions.accepted_format: The organization's name, or a statement that no organization qualified.

questions.title: Which prominent RSF field commander will Darfur's governor announce has been killed in western Sudan in early August 2026?
questions.background: The Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are a paramilitary group fighting Sudan's army in a war that began in April 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the RSF field commander whose death in fighting in western Sudan Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi announces during August 1–10, 2026, according to Al Jazeera's reporting. The question concerns the governor's announcement, not independent confirmation of the death.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-10 (announcement window: August 1–10, 2026)
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the commander's name, omitting military rank and nickname.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the commander's name, omitting military rank and nickname.

questions.title: What sentence will Egyptian television presenter Sarah Khalifa receive at trial in her drug-trafficking case?
questions.background: Sarah Khalifa was arrested in Egypt in April 2025 as part of a drug investigation.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The trial court’s announced judgment in the drug-trafficking prosecution stemming from Khalifa’s April 2025 arrest, as confirmed by official court information or reliable reporting from Al-Ahram.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the trial court announces its verdict and sentence. Later appellate decisions and judgments in unrelated cases do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide a short legal term identifying the principal penalty imposed, or the court’s disposition if no penalty is imposed. If multiple penalties are imposed, report the most severe.
questions.accepted_format: Provide a short legal term identifying the principal penalty imposed, or the court’s disposition if no penalty is imposed. If multiple penalties are imposed, report the most severe.

questions.title: Which country will host Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit as Myanmar's military chief?
questions.background: Ye Win Oo assumed Myanmar's military leadership in April 2026 after Min Aung Hlaing became president.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official statements from the governments involved or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations identifying the destination of Ye Win Oo's first overseas visit after assuming military leadership in April 2026.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve once the visit has begun and is publicly confirmed, rather than when travel plans are merely announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The destination country's common English name.
questions.accepted_format: The destination country's common English name.

questions.title: Which districts will hold polling on August 10 in Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election?
questions.background: Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election is scheduled to take place in three phases.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official election-authority records or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the districts where polling takes place on August 10, 2026.
  • Resolution: The answer will be the complete set of districts within Pakistan-administered Kashmir where Legislative Assembly polling opens on that date.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The district names, joined by “and”.

questions.title: Which branch of Venezuela's government will the first government–opposition talks after Nicolás Maduro's removal agree to overhaul?
questions.background: Nicolás Maduro was removed from power in January 2026, and Delcy Rodríguez became acting president. Previous negotiations between Venezuela's government and opposition have not produced a lasting political settlement.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from the negotiating parties or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the branch of government that both sides agree to comprehensively overhaul during their first formal negotiating round following Maduro's January 2026 removal. The round must conclude by August 31, 2026. An announced agreement is sufficient; implementation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The common name of the governmental branch, rather than an individual institution or officeholder.
questions.accepted_format: The common name of the governmental branch, rather than an individual institution or officeholder.

questions.title: To which hospital will Pakistan’s Supreme Court order Imran Khan transferred for medical care in August 2026?
questions.background: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan is imprisoned at Adiala jail. His eye condition has required specialist treatment, and concerns about his health have been central to his party’s campaign for his release.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Supreme Court’s order or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations describing its requirements.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the hospital designated in the Supreme Court’s next order, issued after the start date and during August 2026, directing Khan’s transfer from Adiala jail for hospital care.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the hospital.
